solver_answer.answer: Yes, it may be a risk, especially if it would leave you needing recovery time before another commitment that requires focused listening. You have described needing a quiet morning after facilitating a lively group gathering, so a bigger Saturday evening event could plausibly create that same strain. Checking your paper calendar for the following morning and protecting recovery time—or declining, shortening, or sharing the hosting role—would be prudent. Your movable, low-stakes Sunday coffee appears easier to adjust than an obligation involving someone else's conflict.
